title: Configuring the Microsoft Intune Audit Events Connector

blocks.text: Microsoft Intune is a cloud-based endpoint management solution. It manages user access to organizational resources and simplifies app and device management across your devices, including mobile devices, desktop computers, and virtual endpoints.
For Microsoft Intune Assets, see Configuring the Microsoft Intune Assets Connector.

To set up the Microsoft Intune Audit Events connector, you must register an application in Microsoft Intune. During the setup process, you can retrieve the required parameters. The Microsoft Graph API for Intune requires an active Intune feature plan for the tenant. If you already have a SecOps application for API, you can assign the application roles. This does not apply to the SAML application.

blocks.item: Register an application
To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide.
Declare roles for an application
To declare roles for an application, refer to the Microsoft documentation. To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide.
Assign application roles
To assign app roles to applications, refer to the Microsoft documentation. For the Permissions step, select the intune read role.
To grant admin consent, refer to the Microsoft documentation.

blocks.text: To configure the Microsoft Intune Audit Events connector, you need the source authentication configuration. The following parameters are required:

blocks.item: Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID

After the registration process is complete, the Microsoft Azure portal displays the application registration Overview page. From the Overview page, save the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID.
Client Secret
To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Microsoft Services Deployment Guide.

blocks.text: To create the Microsoft Intune Audit Events data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Go to Configure > Sources.
Click Create.
Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.
See image.

blocks.text: After you create the Microsoft Intune Audit Events data source, enter the Authentication information in the source setup Retrieval section. To configure authentication:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Microsoft Intune Authentication window appears.
In the Microsoft Intune Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
See image.
Click Create.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
